_comment: Shared registry of projects (workspaces) for the app switcher (/switch). One app process serves one project; this lists the siblings. 'port' is resolved against the requesting host so links work over localhost or Tailscale. Shared across instances (pointed at by WIZARD_PROJECTS_REGISTRY), like models.json.
